import {
  BaseSubgraph,
  type SubgraphArgs,
  type SchemaBuilder,
} from "@powerhousedao/reactor-api";
import { schema } from "./schema.js";
import { extraExample } from "./extra-resolvers.js";

export class ExampleSubgraph extends BaseSubgraph {
  static override readonly subgraphName = "example-custom";
  static override getSchema(schemaBuilder: SchemaBuilder<ExampleSubgraph>) {
    return schemaBuilder.graphql({
      typeDefs: schema,
      resolverCoordinates: [
        {
          typeName: "Query",
          fieldName: "example",
          resolverKind: "field",
        },
        {
          typeName: "ExampleQueries",
          fieldName: "example",
          resolverKind: "field",
        },
      ],
      resolvers: (s) => ({
        Query: { example: () => ({}) },
        ExampleQueries: { example: extraExample },
      }),
    });
  }
  readonly cache = new Map<string, string>();

  constructor(args: SubgraphArgs) {
    super(args);
    this.cache.set("ready", "yes");
  }

  override async onSetup() {
    await super.onSetup();
    this.cache.set("setup", "yes");
  }

  override async onDisconnect() {
    await super.onDisconnect();
    this.cache.clear();
  }

  example() {
    return this.cache.get("ready");
  }
}
